config.label: Identify your own client
config.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so the BnF can always reach a person.

config.label: Minimum milliseconds between requests
config.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 3000, which is also the floor.

config.label: Deadline for one SPARQL query, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one SPARQL query, in milliseconds. Default 60000.

config.label: Attempts after a busy answer
config.description: Attempts after a busy answer. Default 3.

config.label: How long an answer is kept in memory, in milliseconds
config.description: How long an answer is kept in memory, in milliseconds. Default 900000. Zero turns the cache off.

config.label: silent, error, info or debug
config.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
